title: Short-Time Fourier Transform V1.0

Identifier.AIMName: /* The name of the AIM, given by the concatenation of the two strings ImplementerID and ImplementationID, in this order, with no space and no character between them. */

Description: Short-Time Fourier Transform (CAE-SFT) of CAE-6DF V1.0: The SFT AIM takes Audio Objects represented in the time domain as input and outputs Audio Objects in the frequency domain. The SFT uses a Hann window of length N = 2048 with and overlap size of 7/8 N between blocks of data and performs an FFT.
